plan: docs/STAGE_PLAN.md (X4, approved after R2 + user ruling, eab3276); decisions docs/review/DECISIONS.md stage X4; v2 = X4-smokefix: report diagnostics and the identical-prediction rule (smoke x4_efbd0af)
history_rule: X3-HS: every window's GFS history comes from the preparation of its own frozen pack (K/P and HoT train/validation: A3 hourly grid = development preparation; HoT test packs: sealed-prep point cache via run_x2.hot_test_history); bound to x50 channel 20 for every window and hour before use in q1, q2 and q4; the A3 grid may differ from a native source only (a) where A3 is NaN, the native value finite and the hour a development-boundary hour (outside_development), or (b) where A3 is finite, the native value NaN and the hour's available cycle predates the native source's first day (sealed cache start edge, HS0); values never differ
family: A, B1, B2 (Bonferroni over 3); D0 is a feasibility gate, not a claim

a.inputs: single series; upstream NaN on flagged hours for every farm and window; target windows: every channel and the GFS history NaN before D-k; X3-HS history sources
a.source_pool: the frozen L_1X source pool: other two farms, every h1-h4 label strictly before the target's L_1X early-stopping cut; regenerated and checked against X3 q4_meta (target_windows, es_windows, es_cut, fit_windows) for k = 1 and 3
a.stage1_selection: median MAE on the target k=1 early-stopping set; ties -> smaller lr, then earlier step
a.stage2_rule: from the stage-1 selection, lr = stage-1 lr, target k-month fit windows (labels < cut), step 0 is a candidate; k = 1 (C_T1) and k = 3 (C_T3, descriptive)
a.C_D1: from the base model, target k = 1 fit windows, stage-2 steps / evaluation / step-0 rule, lr shared with the stage-1 selection of the same target (R2-S2); descriptive
a.decision: C_T1 vs L_1X on target V1: every farm gain > 0 and pooled CI low > 0 (family z)

b.training_windows: X3 Q2-FT20k npz per farm (path and SHA from the hash-pinned X3 q2_spec.json)
b.context: X3 Q1 selection (1024 h), single series, unmasked as X3 Q2
b.selection: V1 median MAE after reload: candidates [X3 Q2-FT20k (lr 1e-6), lr 3e-6, lr 1e-5]; ties -> earlier candidate

d0.isolation: per block a fixed cut c (es_split); target training windows and every source window: all h1-h4 labels strictly before c; evaluation windows issue >= c; windows crossing c are dropped, never moved (R2-B2)
d0.nonfinite_event_rule: source windows with a non-finite event feature are excluded from that block's pool (count reported)
d0.freeze: standardiser and centres fitted once per pseudo-target on the first block's compliant source pool; later blocks only assign (R2-B1)
d0.proxy: LightGBM L1, fixed trees, no early stopping, Q4 111 columns, one model per horizon; MAE over windows and 4 horizons in per-unit power
d0.timeout_scope: from the end of data preparation (farm_tables, reported separately) to the last proxy fit
d0.invalid: empty group (n = 0), empty block or constant U (Spearman undefined) or timeout -> INCOMPLETE, not a negative result, no rerun (R2-S3)

identical_rule: a development comparison whose candidate equals its reference (e.g. an ensemble with V1 weight w = 1, the registered tie rule's 'no ensemble') has a gain of exactly 0: requirements 'gain > 0' / '>= 1%' fail for that farm, the question is NOT passed and its pooled interval is reported as UNDEFINED_IDENTICAL; any other degenerate interval remains a technical failure, located in report_diagnostics.json
